subtasks.instructions: Compute the average departure delay in minutes across all completed (cancelled=false) flights operated by all six carriers during January and February 2025, using each flight's scheduled departure date/month in the local date at the origin airport. Departure delay is actual departure minus scheduled departure; preserve negative values for early departures. Handle departures after midnight by representing scheduled and actual times as datetimes and assigning actual departures after midnight to the following day when needed. AA, B6, DL, UA, and WN columns are local origin time. AS is the exception: date_utc, sched_dep_utc, and actual_dep_utc are UTC; convert both timestamps to local origin time using airports.csv utc_offset_hours (the relevant dates are Jan-Feb 2025), then filter by local scheduled departure date. Exclude cancelled flights and any rows with missing actual departure. Because exports may contain repeated records, deduplicate by flight_id before aggregating (verify duplicate rows are identical or explain any conflict). Calculate total completed-flight count, sum of delays, and mean delay; include enough intermediate checks to validate timezone conversion, date filtering, midnight rollover, and negative delays. Do not use weather files.

Departure delay is actual departure minus scheduled departure; preserve negative values for early departures. Handle departures after midnight by representing scheduled and actual times as datetimes and assigning actual departures after midnight to the following day when needed. AA, B6, DL, UA, and WN columns are local origin time. Exclude cancelled flights and any rows with missing actual departure. Because exports may contain repeated records, deduplicate by flight_id before aggregating (verify duplicate rows are identical or explain any conflict). Calculate total completed-flight count, sum of delays, and mean delay; include enough intermediate checks to validate timezone conversion, date filtering, midnight rollover, and negative delays. Do not use weather files.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from datetime import timedelta
aps=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
allrows=[]; dupinfo={}
for c in ['AA','AS','B6','DL','UA','WN']:
 df=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{c}.csv')
 ndup=df.duplicated('flight_id',keep=False).sum(); groups=df.groupby('flight_id',dropna=False)
 conflicts=[]
 for fid,g in groups:
  if len(g)>1 and len(g.drop_duplicates())>1: conflicts.append((fid,len(g),g.to_dict('records')))
 dupinfo[c]={'rows':len(df),'unique':df.flight_id.nunique(),'duplicate_rows':ndup,'duplicate_ids':df.flight_id.duplicated().sum(),'conflicts':len(conflicts)}
 df=df.drop_duplicates('flight_id',keep='first').copy(); df['carrier']=c
 if c!='AS':
  df['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(df.date+' '+df.sched_dep)
  df['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(df.date+' '+df.actual_dep,errors='coerce')
  # rollover when actual clock < scheduled; only nonmissing
  mask=(df.actual_dep.notna() & df.sched_dep.notna() & (df.actual_dep < df.sched_dep))
  df.loc[mask,'actual_dt'] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
 else:
  # UTC date/time then local offset
  df['sched_utc']=pd.to_datetime(df.date_utc+' '+df.sched_dep_utc)
  df['actual_utc']=pd.to_datetime(df.date_utc+' '+df.actual_dep_utc,errors='coerce')
  offs=df.origin.map(aps.utc_offset_hours)
  df['sched_dt']=df.sched_utc-pd.to_timedelta(offs,unit='h')
  df['actual_dt']=df.actual_utc-pd.to_timedelta(offs,unit='h')
  # UTC actual date potentially next day? data date likely scheduled date and actual after midnight represented? inspect later
 df['delay']=(df.actual_dt-df.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
 df['local_sched_date']=df.sched_dt.dt.date
 allrows.append(df)
x=pd.concat(allrows,ignore_index=True)
period=(x.local_sched_date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(x.local_sched_date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())
completed=(x.cancelled==False)&x.actual_dt.notna()&period
z=x[completed]
print(dupinfo)
print('total',len(x),'period',period.sum(),'completed',len(z),'sum',z.delay.sum(),'mean',z.delay.mean())
print('cancelled total', (x.cancelled==True).sum(),'cancelled in period',((x.cancelled==True)&period).sum(),'missing actual',x.actual_dt.isna().sum(),'missing in period', (x.actual_dt.isna()&period).sum())
print('rollovers nonAS',[(c,int(((d.actual_dep<d.sched_dep)&d.actual_dep.notna()).sum())) for c,d in [(c,pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{c}.csv')) for c in ['AA','B6','DL','UA','WN']]])
print('neg', (z.delay<0).sum(), 'min',z.delay.min(),'max',z.delay.max())
print(z.groupby('carrier').agg(n=('delay','size'),sum=('delay','sum'),mean=('delay','mean')))
print('AS sample local boundaries',x[x.carrier=='AS'][['date_utc','sched_dep_utc','origin','sched_dt','actual_dt','delay']].head(10).to_string(index=False))

# inspect local files times where actual<sched, focusing scheduled hour and time diffs
for c in ['AA','B6','DL','UA','WN']:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{c}.csv'); q=d[d.actual_dep.notna() & (d.actual_dep<d.sched_dep)].copy(); q['diff']=(pd.to_timedelta(q.actual_dep+':00')-pd.to_timedelta(q.sched_dep+':00')).dt.total_seconds()/60
 print('\n',c,len(q)); print(q[['date','origin','sched_dep','actual_dep']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
print('sched times near late with backwards')
# all candidates
for c in ['AA','B6','DL','UA','WN']:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{c}.csv'); q=d[d.actual_dep.notna() & (d.actual_dep<d.sched_dep) & (d.sched_dep>='20:00')]; print(c,len(q),q[['sched_dep','actual_dep']].value_counts().head().to_dict())

# recompute with rollover only large backward jumps, AS too; local date based sched
rows=[]
for c in ['AA','AS','B6','DL','UA','WN']:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{c}.csv').drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy(); d['carrier']=c
 if c=='AS':
  su=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc); au=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc,errors='coerce'); off=d.origin.map(aps.utc_offset_hours)
  s=su-pd.to_timedelta(off,unit='h'); a=au-pd.to_timedelta(off,unit='h')
 else:
  s=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep); a=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep,errors='coerce')
 raw=(a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60
 roll=(raw < -60)
 a=a+pd.to_timedelta(roll.astype(int),unit='D')
 d['s']=s;d['a']=a;d['delay']=(a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60;d['roll']=roll;rows.append(d)
x=pd.concat(rows); x['sd']=x.s.dt.date
p=(x.sd>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(x.sd<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date()); z=x[p&(x.cancelled==False)&x.a.notna()]
print(len(z),z.delay.sum(),z.delay.mean(),'roll',z.roll.sum(),'neg',(z.delay<0).sum(),'min',z.delay.min(),'max',z.delay.max())
print(z.groupby('carrier').agg(n=('delay','size'),sum=('delay','sum'),mean=('delay','mean')))
print(x[x.roll][['carrier','s','a','delay']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
print('period source count',p.sum(),'cancel',((x.cancelled==True)&p).sum())
